summary_1line: A virtuous fowler reveals he was once a Brahmana cursed after accidentally wounding a rishi, teaching that character and duty outweigh birth.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a forest near a hermitage, a wounded rishi lies on the ground pierced by an arrow as the shocked Brahmana hunter realizes his mistake.
The enraged rishi, still bleeding, raises himself and pronounces a curse turning the trembling Brahmana into a future fowler.
The humble fowler stands speaking calmly to the visiting Brahmana, explaining wisdom about virtue and contentment beside a rustic hut.
